Coverage_Description: Scaling/polishing (K12: twice/year; K21: once/year), oral check-up & hygiene instruction, necessary intra-oral X-ray and fluoride varnish, caries fillings, simple extraction, and emergency temporary pain/filling/absc; excludes wisdom/surgical/orthodontic extractions and specialist treatment
pricing: K12: HK$420; K21: HK$370; optional professional 1-hour tooth whitening: HK$6,300 (original HK$7,800).
customer requirement: ESOU company staff and their family members only
price structure: Fixed fee by plan option (K12/K21) with optional add-on package; separate discounted itemized charges for other treatments
additional informations: Free consultation/examination for oral implant "Teeth-in-an-hour" at Central Clinic; prices subject to change without prior notice
